author: Ifmyante
text:
I'll be doing a lot of mind dumping in here for a while.

Take nothing as a complete lesson unless I've said it is

If your rectangle is above price, it must always be drawn from a low to the highest high on its right.

If your rectangle is below price, it must always be drawn from an high to the lowest low on its right.

To be tradeable, rectangles must cross lines drawn from highs and lows to the left

author: Ifmyante
text:
Who will not be able to understand the market?

The market is an herd, putting in cash.

The cash goes straight back to the people who created it out of nothing and loaned to them in the first place!

So, to understand the market is to understand the herd (of cash cows, in this case).

Can anybody in the herd understand the market?

People who understand the herd, leave the herd, so the answer is "yes, but only for a split second!"

So, if you want to know whether you'll be a great trader, simply ask yourself:

Do I believe in gods?

Do I believe in governments?

Do I believe in royalty?

Do I believe the news?

Do we have an emperor?

If the answer to more than one of these questions is "yes", then you're not ready to understand the market

Hi Guys !

I'm sure IF will shed some light on this matter soon but my current
understanding is this(the final move of a PAz after the swapping of
orders is where i need to work on my understanding ):

It all depens on what we have to the left -

If there is nothing to the left (this is the most likely the case here
because in the class it was about PA in the same "scale") then an engulf
 of the SR of the Flad usually states that price will go to the next
target inside the Flag. It may retrace to the UFL or it may not (that is
 conditioned in my oppinion by the ammount of orders the IT need to fill
 untill they proceed to the next target and the ammount they have
already filled) and of course it may retrace to the MPL of UFL A
without touching B which is the best scenario . The orange kink is valid
 but it is in a smaller scale and can be traded accordingly within it's
limitations .

Of course in this case, for a sell at UFL the SL should always be above A if price hasn't touched B yet.

We would need a more complete picture to the left to evaulate if the
orange rectangle is a FL in this scale...but from this picture is only a
 kink .

E.
